subject: {{team_name}} has been selected for {{event_name}}
text:
Dear {{participant_name}},

Congratulations from ACM-VIT!

Your team, {{team_name}}, has been selected for {{event_name}}. Congratulations!

Selection does not confirm your RSVP. Your team lead must open the C2C portal and choose Confirm RSVP for the whole team before the RSVP deadline shown there. If your team cannot attend, choose Decline.

Please check the portal for your RSVP status, event details, and arrival instructions.

View selection and RSVP: {{portal_url}}

Event Discord: https://discord.gg/hPkhtMcHq8

Best regards,
ACM-VIT Student Chapter
